items.title: TTD Q2 Deep Dive: Macro Headwinds and Execution Shortfalls Shape Outlook
items.summary: Digital advertising platform The Trade Desk (NASDAQ:TTD) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026 as sales rose 3% year on year to $715.1 million. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $650 million underwhelmed, coming in 19.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.34 per share was 15.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
